Exercise normal precaution

in **Fiji**. Some areas have increased risk. Read the entire Travel Advisory.

Fiji is generally a safe destination for travelers.

  * Review our [Travel Guidance for Fiji](/en/international-travel/travel-advisories/fiji.html#requirements) to learn how to prepare for a safe trip.



**Exercise increased caution** in **Colo I Suva Forest Park** due to the risk of **crime**.
